subject.convention: source declarations; no identity, frame or health inference

record_time_us.unit: caller capture microseconds; Unknown basis, not event time

log_created_at_seconds.unit: reported API Unix seconds; may be caller supplied, not guaranteed occurrence time

log_type_reported.unit: known category or unknown:percent-encoded-UTF8; not ranked or physical severity

log_type_disposition.unit: QUALIFIED_CATEGORY or UNKNOWN_CATEGORY; unknown raw type retained

log_message.unit: text:percent-encoded-UTF8 reported event text; decode percent escapes once; not commands or verified facts

log_time_disposition.unit: MISSING, NULL or REPORTED_API_TIME; no capture substitution

log_verbosity_reported.unit: producer-reported verbosity integer, not physical severity

log_id_reported.unit: API Log id, not device identity

device_identity_declared.unit: text:percent-encoded-UTF8 caller association; not serialized authenticated device id

source_record_hex.unit: exact selected UTF-8 line, unknown fields retained

source_record_index.unit: zero-based original physical line with window CLI

source_file_sha256.unit: original bytes digest with window CLI; not authentication

selected_normalized_sha256.unit: LF-normalized selected content digest, distinct from original
